name: @w6w-apps/runway
description: Generate video, images, speech and sound with Runway: start generation tasks, poll them to completion, run saved workflows and model routers, and read credits and usage.

w6w.longDescription:
Runway is a generative media platform. Its developer API starts video, image, audio and speech generations on Runway's own and partner models and returns a task id that is polled to completion.

A workflow can start a text-to-video, image-to-video or video-to-video generation, make an image from a prompt and reference images, upscale an image or video, convert a video to HDR, drive a character with a reference performance, speak a script, convert, dub or isolate a voice, or generate a sound effect. Every generation returns a task id; Get Task reads its status, progress, cost and (once it has SUCCEEDED) the temporary output URLs, and Cancel Task stops or deletes it. A saved Model Router can pick the model for a video generation instead of naming one, a published Runway workflow can be run and its invocation read back, and the account's credit balance, usage tier and per-model credit usage are readable for free. Avatars, custom voices and routers can be listed and read.

The connection holds a Runway API secret (Developer Portal, key_...), sent as a bearer token. Generation spends credits; request fields differ per model, so each generation action takes the model id plus the commonly used fields and an `extra` JSON object for any model-specific field.
